q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: SELECT b.name AS bar_name, COALESCE(SUM(f.times_a_week), 0) AS total_num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT name FROM (SELECT d.name, SUM(f.times_a_week) AS total_times FROM drinker AS d JOIN frequents AS f ON d.name = f.drinker WHERE f.bar = b.name GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY total_times DESC, d.name ASC LIMIT 1) AS max_reg_drinker) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY total_num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
